2105-4068-4598-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4068-4598-8330.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4068-4598-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

4050-4681-5170-8292.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Massacre Girl trigger.
Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

856-2267-4321-8249.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2267-4321-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

4279-6578-7316--216.easyPrerequisites:
You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6578-7316--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Sephiroth, Rat King and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Rat King ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sephiroth triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1170-1518-8164.easyPrerequisites:
There are at least two cards in your deck.
There's at least two loyalty counters on Will Kenrith.
Heartwood Crafter is prepared.
1170-1518-8164.description:
Activate Will's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to draw two cards and reduce the costs of instants, sorceries and planeswalker spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Heartwood Crafter. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat from step 2

2178-2380-5231.easyPrerequisites:
Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
2178-2380-5231.description:
Activate Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
Repeat.

6797-7388--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Rocksteady triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat

2728-5256-6012-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-5256-6012-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-5256-6012-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 4.

215-3443-3499.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
215-3443-3499.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-3443-3499.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

215-955-1355.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
215-955-1355.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sanctum Weaver from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sanctum Weaver by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

215-1322-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 6 or greater.
215-1322-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Arbor Adherent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Arbor Adherent by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4369-4490.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to an opponent.
4369-4490.description:
Any opponent takes damage.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a counter on a permanent.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing at least 1 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

433-765-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
433-765-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3532-3836-5078-7314.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Baxter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

4038-5711-5963.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.

3750-5471-7020-7131.easyPrerequisites: Braid of Fire has an age counter on it, or Obeka's power is 3 or greater.
3750-5471-7020-7131.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Obeka. Obeka triggers, causing you to get that many upkeep steps after this one.
Move to your first extra upkeep. At the beginning of that upkeep, Braid of Fire triggers, putting an age counter on it and adding {R} for each age counter on it.
Repeat step 2 for each other upkeep step.
During your postcombat main phase, activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

969-2366-4974-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
969-2366-4974-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1232-1270-5477-7060.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

14-141-6798.description:
Cast Reincarnation by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Reincarnation, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Reincarnation.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Reincarnation triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 5.

1978-2593-4694.description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1062-3484-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
392-1062-3484-5674.description:
Activate Harnfel by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Harnfel ability.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

2866-3689-6518-6709.notablePrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2866-3689-6518-6709.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

969-6575-6684.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of The First Tyrannic War and then putting two lore counters on it.
The First Tyrannic War token's first, second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger. Then, resolve the second trigger, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the third First Tyrannic War trigger, putting two lore counters on Esper Terra and causing you to sacrifice the First Tyrannic War token.
Esper Terra's third and fourth chapter abilities trigger. Resolve the third ability's trigger, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the fourth trigger, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1808-2829-6291.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional artifact creature.
1808-2829-6291.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing another creature you control.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

3888-4613-6310.notablePrerequisites:
Olivia's Attendants has a +1/+1 counter on it.
You control two untapped artifacts.
You have two or more opponents.
3888-4613-6310.description:
Activate Olivia's Attendants using Shao Jun's ability by tapping two artifacts, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Olivia's Attendants triggers, creating a Blood token for each point of damage dealt by it.
Repeat.
3888-4613-6310.notes: The combo fails to provide enough Bloods once you only have one opponent remaining. If you have three or more opponents, you will get extra Bloods which can be used once you only have one opponent remaining for additional iterations.

3967-6247-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
3967-6247-6249--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and High-Society Hunter trigger.
Resolve the High-Society Hunter trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1563-5365-5455.notablePrerequisites: Lonis has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
1563-5365-5455.description:
Activate Bristly Bill by paying {3}{G}{G}, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on Lonis.
Lonis's first ability triggers for each counter placed on it, creating that many Clue tokens.
Activate five Clues by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

2498-4322.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 8.
2498-4322.description:
Activate Griselbrand by paying 7 life, causing you to draw seven cards.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers seven times, causing you to gain 14 life.
Repeat.

628-914-4153-5147.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
Dockside Extortionist does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-914-4153-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{W}.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving all +1/+1 counters from Dockside Extortionist onto another permanent you control.
Repeat.
If opponents control six or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

1409-2208-2397.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Charming Scoundrel.
1409-2208-2397.description:
Activate Charming Scoundrel by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Charming Scoundrel enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Charming Scoundrel.
Resolve both Charming Scoundrel triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

1110-2474-3059.description:
Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Malignus enters the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing an amount of damage equal to three times Malignus' power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

4533-4659-5003.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nontoken artifact creature.
You control less than four Blood tokens.
4533-4659-5003.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a nontoken artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Voldaren Bloodcaster and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Voldaren Bloodcaster trigger, creating a Blood artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Blood token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return the artifact creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

2034-4215-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a green nontoken creature.
2034-4215-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a green nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, returning the creature from your library to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1475-2744-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one modified creature with power one or greater.
1475-2744-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other modified creature you control with power one or greater, adding one mana of any color.
One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
The Spirit tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade that many times, putting that many +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Repeat.

930-1789-2232-2440.description:
Cast Universal Automaton by paying {1}.
Universal Automaton enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes and Lathliss.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
The Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Universal Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Dragon you control.
Repeat.

1656-2838-4762.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1656-2838-4762.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Necrotic Ooze by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

654-2203-2893-4500.notablePrerequisites: Fertilid has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
654-2203-2893-4500.description:
Activate Fertilid, searching your library for a basic Forest card, putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Retreat to Kazandu triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter Fertilid.
Tap the land for {G}{G}.
Repeat.

3821-5140-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
3821-5140-5256.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Peregrine Drake, causing target player to mill cards equal to Peregrine Drake's power.
Repeat.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

225-539-1993-3147.notablePrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
225-539-1993-3147.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Budoka Gardener as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

2438-4275-4599.notablePrerequisites: At least four other Zombies on the battlefield.
2438-4275-4599.description:
Sacrifice Carrion Feeder to itself.
Untap all zombies.
Tap 5 untapped zombies you control to return Carrion Feeder to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-2608-5116.notablePrerequisites: {1} plus three additional mana in at least two colors among {W}, {U}, or
2034-2608-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}, {U}{U}{U}, or {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it onto the battlefield from the command zone.
Derevi enters the battlefield, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Derevi, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to put Derevi into the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1657-2292-3908.description:
Cast Spark Double choosing to have it enter as a copy of Murderous Redcap, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Sacrifice the Spark Double to Viscera Seer, triggering persist.
The -1/-1 counter from persist and the +1/+1 counter from Spark Double cancel each other out and you deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat until opponent are dead.

38-659-3750.easyPrerequisites: Krenko does not have summoning sickness.
38-659-3750.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Goblins.
38-659-3750.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least five 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Skirk Prospector five times by sacrificing five Goblin tokens, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one
Repeat.
